text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian continues to run with everything she's got, but she realizes that she is physically reaching her peak as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, despite the pain that comes with it, all she can do to satisfy herself is continue running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun recognizes Narita Brian's true intentions behind her racing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows that, just as Narita Brian once excited her, she will excite Narita Brian with her own running abilities.
